evidence.title: QM from YC docs/swarms.md
evidence.locator: Worker goals; Human API; Controls; Defaults
evidence.finding: Swarms expose hierarchical worker controls, durable messages/session results and linked worker transcripts. Paused notifications wait; Stop aborts and prevents later worker turns. Goal token caps and optional time/message budgets exist. Provisioning has bounded pools/deadlines and cleanup reconciliation; shared forum outlives worker cleanup.

evidence.title: QM from YC docs/mcp-connectors.md
evidence.finding: Administrators register HTTP MCP servers; agents cannot change registration. Tools can use shared or per-user encrypted credentials with OAuth/PKCE; calls re-resolve actor credentials and never fall back to another user. Approval is exact-argument one-call, controlled by annotations/all/none.

evidence.title: QM from YC docs/files-publication.md
evidence.locator: Agent usage; Protocol; Deployment and recovery
evidence.finding: Files uploads publish durable S3 bytes/metadata separate from sandbox life. Actor/conversation-bound multipart transfer resumes from durable state, has 100 GiB file/four active-upload limits and 24-hour expiry. Deletion records tombstones. Published artifact remains after sandbox retirement.

evidence.title: QM from YC docs/session-sharing.md
evidence.finding: Share creates immutable read-only snapshot of visible messages/replies/attachments. Internal audience needs internal sign-in; public bearer link permits downloads. evidence.title: QM from YC docs/memory-records.md
evidence.locator: Capture and curation; Fresh reads; Retained context
evidence.finding: Built-in memory has stable record IDs, sensitivity, source scope/session and provenance flags. Revisions are authoritative in Postgres; edits require revision checks, clearing does not erase historical revisions. Access rechecks sources on every read; audience change advances replay cutoff while transcripts/audit remain.

evidence.title: QM from YC docs/sandbox-resources.md
evidence.finding: Sandbox resources have owning scope/provider/lifecycle and explicit default routing. Background jobs are durable targets controlled by poll/send_input/stop/watch. Cross-scope credential jobs use isolated scratch/job computers. Provider expiry/loss may interrupt jobs; retirement deletes working state, not published Files.

evidence.title: QM from YC docs/sandbox-preservation.md
evidence.finding: Provider-specific snapshots/pause behavior differs. Modal default one core/2 GiB and 24-hour lifetime; portable tar recovery needs configured S3 bucket. DigitalOcean Managed Agents sandbox template is a microVM with persistent disk across pause/resume. Cold recovery may restore files without processes.

evidence.title: QM README (v0.1.18)
evidence.locator: Setup; Features; Architecture; How it works; Security and secrets
evidence.finding: Headless core (API, identity, policy, scheduler) runs the Pi agent loop for every turn against Postgres and per-scope sandboxes. Setup: an agent follows the deployment guide; DigitalOcean, E2B and Render offer one-click templates; Agent 37 is a third-party fully hosted option; YC offers an interest form for a hosted version, not a service. Features: web apps published to chosen people, skill packs imported from git, crons, watches and inbound webhooks. Auto posture (default) blocks private-network access; the agent acts as the person and its actions are audited. Org config, custom tools, skills and sandbox image live in a deployment directory.

evidence.title: QM LICENSE and repository layout (v0.1.18)
evidence.finding: LICENSE is MIT (QM contributors). The headless core (src/), deployment CLI (cli/), web UI and Slack plugins (plugins/), desktop/ and ios/ clients sit in the same repository with no separate license file.

evidence.title: QM v0.1.16 release notes
evidence.finding: Spend visibility (people see what their work costs; admins set spend caps), one-step offboarding, and Breaking: one agent harness (Claude via Pi), Postgres-only storage, several legacy features and settings removed.

evidence.title: QM v0.1.18 release notes
evidence.finding: v0.1.18 (2026-11-11) is the latest stable release after v0.1.17 (2026-11-10) and v0.1.16 (2026-11-04); v0.1.19 (2026-11-12) and desktop-v0.1.6 (2026-11-06, Apple Silicon) are prereleases. Versions remain pre-1.0.

evidence.title: QM migration runtime/0002-drop-harness-choice (v0.1.18)
evidence.finding: A runtime migration drops approved_harness_configs and strips harnessId from model, cron, subagent, fallback and swarm configs: there is no per-run harness choice; every turn uses the built-in Pi coding agent.

evidence.title: QM deployment CLI commands (v0.1.18)
evidence.finding: qm commands are deployment and operations only: init, check, config, infra, plan, up, down, status, logs, migrate, secrets, tenant, sandbox, layer, ui, slack, outputs, rollback, doctor, admin-login. No command starts or steers agent work; that uses the core HTTP API.

evidence.title: QM webhook routes (v0.1.18)
evidence.finding: POST /v1/webhooks creates a webhook for a person; POST /v1/webhooks/incoming/:id receives verified deliveries that wake an agent turn; list, events and update routes exist.

evidence.title: QM docs: Deployment directory contract (v0.1.18)
evidence.locator: Layout; Tool descriptors; Delivery and pins; Sandbox egress proxy
evidence.finding: sandbox/tools/<id>/tool.json plus binaries add custom tools and sandbox/skills/<id>/SKILL.md adds skills; plugins/ adds services. qm up syncs them to core as a versioned, audited deployment layer. An optional egress-proxy service forces sandbox traffic through a proxy that relays audit records, except exempt backends.

evidence.title: QM docs: Skill registry (v0.1.18)
evidence.finding: An org admin registers a git repository of SKILL.md files as a pack at a pinned ref, browses it and imports eligible skills into chosen scopes; updates bump the ref and re-import; admin routes are audited.

evidence.title: QM desktop README (v0.1.18)
evidence.finding: Electron client for an existing QM web deployment that runs the same web UI in a sandboxed window; does not bundle the backend. The macOS build is an unsigned local prototype.

evidence.title: QM for iOS README (v0.1.18)
evidence.finding: iOS 18+ SwiftUI client; product screens, navigation, editors and conversation controls are native, with no embedded WebKit product UI; uses existing authenticated APIs and runs no agent on the phone. Built from source with Xcode.

evidence.title: QM cron schedules and routes (v0.1.18)
evidence.locator: normalizeSchedule; src/api/routes/crons.ts route table; src/cron/scheduler.ts createScheduler
evidence.finding: Crons take a cron expression with timezone, an everyMs interval or a first-fire time; the core scheduler fires them on the deployment without a client; /v1/crons creates and lists them.

evidence.title: QM docs: Deploy QM for an organization (v0.1.18)
evidence.finding: qm init creates a deployment directory from the npm package in an operator-owned repository; the agent confirms the operator's own cloud account and billing; sign-in uses the built-in email auth broker or the operator's identity provider. No QM or YC vendor account is part of setup.

evidence.title: QM SECURITY.md (v0.1.18)
evidence.locator: Assets and actors; Trust boundaries and operator assumptions
evidence.finding: Assets include conversation and model request data, memory, files, workspaces and audit records. The operator controls the cloud account, database, object storage, keys and identity provider; model providers receive the prompts and request data sent to them; browser providers receive browser traffic.

evidence.title: QM Loop item types (v0.1.18)
evidence.locator: LoopItemStatus; LoopItemPriority; LoopItemTriage; docs/loop-ingestion.md Preview rollout
evidence.finding: Loop (Inbox) items carry status (queued, in_progress, ready, shipped, failed, skipped) and triage priority (urgent, high, normal, low). The inbox_loops feature flag defaults off and gates Inbox and Loops per personal scope.

evidence.title: QM commit: Remove the run task list (#2274)
evidence.finding: The run task list with title, sessionId, originRunId and state was removed on 2026-10-14; v0.1.18 has no src/tasks directory.

evidence.title: QM project store roster rules (v0.1.18)
evidence.finding: Projects have one owner and members. Any active member can add internal members and set the icon; only the owner can remove members or rename; other actors get forbidden. Roster changes are audited.

evidence.title: QM security posture policies (v0.1.18)
evidence.finding: auto (default) denies private networks without tool approvals; strict requires approval for every tool call; dangerous has neither gate. Only auto sets denyPrivateNetworks.

evidence.title: QM docs: Persistent subagent sessions (v0.1.18)
evidence.finding: Reusing a request key recovers the same child and initial run after a lost receipt; using the key for different work is rejected. Stable call IDs deduplicate message retries.

evidence.title: QM spend limits (v0.1.18)
evidence.finding: Per-scope dailyUsd and monthlyUsd limits with an org per-person default; at the cap new turns are refused with a message until the UTC reset. No threshold alert or notification path exists in the module.

evidence.title: QM spend reports and export (v0.1.18)
evidence.finding: Admin and self spend reports give cost, calls and input/output/cache tokens by day or week, broken down by person, scope, cron, model, live versus background; GET /v1/spend/export exports rows with an export token. Reports group by scope and cron, not by individual session.

evidence.title: QM web UI spend page (v0.1.18)
evidence.finding: The spend page states that amounts are QM's estimates at each model's list price, so the organization's bill can differ.

evidence.title: QM per-call cost calculation (v0.1.18)
evidence.finding: Per-request costUsd is calculated from token usage and the served model's price card (calculateCost), not read from a provider bill.

evidence.title: QM agent API catalog: published apps (v0.1.18)
evidence.locator: apps publish and deployments share, lines 411-452
evidence.finding: Agents publish apps (apps action publish) reachable only by the owner and people it is shared with by scope, teammate or email (view or manage); public links are refused unless an org admin enables external sharing.

evidence.title: QM admin offboarding (v0.1.18)
evidence.locator: offboardUser; admin user offboard POST route (principalId path parameter)
evidence.finding: An admin previews or applies offboarding of a user in one call; applied steps are run and each is audited; reactivation exists.

evidence.title: QM audit log (v0.1.18)
evidence.finding: Audit events record actor, action, resource, scope and status for approvals, security flags, credentials, connectors, sharing, sandboxes, sessions and admin changes, read through GET /v1/admin/audit. Every tool call is committed to the session item log.

evidence.title: QM GitHub releases
evidence.finding: v0.1.18 (2026-11-11) is marked Latest; v0.1.19 (2026-11-12) is a pre-release. Earlier stable releases are v0.1.17 (2026-11-10) and v0.1.16 (2026-11-04). No release cadence is stated in the releases, README or SECURITY.md.

evidence.title: QM spend code bounded search (v0.1.18)
evidence.locator: Searched src/ and plugins/web-ui/src at 9c20219 for invoice, reconcil, billing and provider usage/cost-report calls; spend files src/api/routes/admin/spend.ts, src/sessions/session-spend.ts, src/ratelimit/spend-limits.ts, src/model/model-runtime.ts, plugins/web-ui/src/spend.ts and plugins/web-ui/src/admin/spend.ts
evidence.finding: Within the named v0.1.18 spend/model/UI paths, spend rows come from per-request costUsd calculated from token usage and the model price card, with no provider-bill or invoice import/reconciliation path found. Reconcile functions elsewhere do not touch spend; this finding does not enumerate every unrelated reconcile function. The billing field in model-route.ts labels which key (gateway, org or personal) a request is billed to.

evidence.title: QM Loop ledger item routes (v0.1.18)
evidence.locator: loopItemRoutes; src/api/agent-api-catalog.ts loop ledger guidance; src/api/routes/loops.ts forInboxLoopsPeople
evidence.finding: A Loop's ledger is a durable queue of work items. POST /v1/loops/:id/items upserts items, GET lists them with counts per state, and item actions edit the proposal, dismiss or reopen an item or run the source's ship action; a follow-up thread can be attached per item. Item, inbox and action routes return feature_disabled unless the inbox_loops flag is on for the person's scope.
